text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I see… So Umamusume families share and pass down their assets and knowledge among their members. In order to learn more about their strength…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I talk to Daiichi Ruby from the most prestigious of households! She tells me that she and her family are one and the same.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: With their incredible sense of unity backed up by wealth and knowledge, it's no wonder they're strong. But I can't just sit back and watch those who were set up for success do all the winning!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You aren't limited to only forming bonds with people in your family! My trainer and I will show that bonds can be formed with anyone!
